name: popover
title: Popover 弹出层
description: 点击触发的小浮层，展示附加内容或简短表单。

whenToUse: 点击后显示少量内容或控件
accessibility: 由按钮触发，Esc 关闭并归还焦点
responsive: 窄屏下自动翻转位置并保持在视口内

files.content:
# Popover 设计规范

- 用于点击后出现、可以操作的轻量面板，如小表单、筛选、选择器；纯文字提示用 Tooltip，一组操作命令用 Dropdown Menu，较长流程用 Dialog。
- 打开它的按钮通过 `Popover.Trigger` 的 `{#snippet child({ props })}` 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）。
- 面板有标题时用 `Popover.Header`、`Popover.Title`、`Popover.Description`，不要自己写加粗文字。
- 位置用 `side`、`align`、`sideOffset` 属性；面板会自动翻转并保持在视口内，不要用 `class` 写定位。
- 工具栏的分组设置用 `appearance="options"`，由内容组提供 8 × 16 px 内边距，32 px 行容纳紧凑选择器、复选框和简短标签。组之间用 Separator。面板按锚点和视口缩小，长内容在面板内滚动。
- 内容组件自带内边距时（如 Command、Calendar）可给默认 `Popover.Content` 加 `p-0`；需要与触发按钮同宽时用 `w-(--bits-popover-anchor-width)`，其他宽度用已有尺寸档位。
- 搜索选择（Combobox）用 Popover + Command，日期选择用 Popover + Calendar，照对应文档的组合写法，不要另做一个下拉组件。
- 面板里的操作完成后需要关闭时，用 `bind:open` 设为 `false` 或用 `Popover.Close`；关闭后焦点回到触发按钮。
- 面板默认使用 12 px 圆角、实色底和 10 px 内边距。工作区筛选、属性和对话历史可用 `appearance="surface"` 应用工作区的 Command 行密度。Command 搜索输入在打开时聚焦，关闭后回到触发器。

<script lang="ts">
	import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

	let { ref = $bindable(null), ...restProps }: PopoverPrimitive.CloseProps = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Close bind:ref data-slot="popover-close" {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
	import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn, type WithoutChildrenOrChild } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import PopoverPortal from "./popover-portal.svelte";
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		appearance = "default",
		sideOffset = 4,
		align = "center",
		strategy = "fixed",
		portalProps,
		forceMount = false,
		...restProps
	}: PopoverPrimitive.ContentProps & {
		appearance?: "default" | "surface" | "options";
		portalProps?: WithoutChildrenOrChild<ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPortal>>;
	} = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPortal {...portalProps}>
	<PopoverPrimitive.Content
		bind:ref
		data-slot="popover-content"
		{sideOffset}
		{align}
		{strategy}
		{forceMount}
		data-appearance={appearance}
		class={cn(
			"data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 flex flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-[12px] p-2.5 text-sm duration-100 motion-reduce:animate-none! border-[0.5px] border-[lch(91.9%_0_282)] bg-[color:var(--valar-overlay-background,white)] text-[color:var(--valar-overlay-foreground,lch(20%_1_282))] shadow-[var(--valar-overlay-shadow,0_3px_8px_#00000020,0_2px_5px_#00000020,0_1px_1px_#00000020)] dark:border-[lch(25.68%_1.93_272)] dark:bg-[color:var(--valar-overlay-background,lch(12.72%_0.85_272))] dark:text-[color:var(--valar-overlay-foreground,lch(91.178%_1.425_272))] max-h-[min(calc(100dvh-1rem),var(--bits-popover-content-available-height,100dvh))] max-w-[min(calc(100dvw-1rem),var(--bits-popover-content-available-width,100dvw))] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain [--valar-overlay-shadow:0_6px_18px_rgb(0_0_0/.02),0_3px_9px_rgb(0_0_0/.04),0_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.04)] dark:[--valar-overlay-shadow:0_3px_8px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_2px_5px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.125)] z-50 origin-(--bits-popover-content-transform-origin) outline-hidden",
			appearance === "options" ? "w-[330px]" : "w-72",
			appearance === "surface" && "[&_[data-slot=command-item]]:min-h-8 [&_[data-slot=command-item]]:gap-2 [&_[data-slot=command-item]]:text-[13px] [&_[data-slot=command-item]]:rounded-[7px] [&_[data-slot=command-item][data-selected]]:bg-accent [&_[data-slot=command-item][data-focused]]:bg-accent animate-none!",
			appearance === "options" && "gap-0 p-0 text-[13px] animate-none!",
			// Bits keeps the floating wrapper until its next frame. A closed work-area panel
			// must already be hidden so it cannot overflow the viewport or capture focus.
			appearance !== "default" &&
				!forceMount &&
				"[[data-bits-floating-content-wrapper]:has(>&[data-state=closed])]:hidden",
			className
		)}
		collisionPadding={8}
		{...restProps}
	/>
</PopoverPortal>
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

	let { ...restProps }: PopoverPrimitive.PortalProps = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Portal {...restProps} />
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: PopoverPrimitive.TriggerProps = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Trigger
	bind:ref
	data-slot="popover-trigger"
	class={cn(className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

	let { open = $bindable(false), ...restProps }: PopoverPrimitive.RootProps = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Root bind:open {...restProps} />
